_comment: Copy this to config.json inside your recording folder and edit. Tells the pipeline how to process this recording. See docs/SUITE2P_SETTINGS.md for how to pick native_fps.
_indicator_options: SS9 jGCaMP8s | SS10 jGCaMP8f | Fluo-4 AM (legacy)
_native_fps_help: True frame rate from the TIF timestamps, NOT the Suite2p GUI default. jGCaMP8s: acquire/analyze at 45 Hz. jGCaMP8f: acquire at 100 Hz (do NOT downsample the fast indicator).
_route_options: cascade_gc8s (jGCaMP8s -> CASCADE GC8s, model rate 45 Hz) | cascade_gc8f (jGCaMP8f -> CASCADE GC8f, model rate 100 Hz) | dff (Fluo-4 dye -> dF/F0 event detection, no CASCADE; legacy, retired going forward)
_route_help: CASCADE auto-resamples the data to the model rate internally; no separate downsample step. CASCADE is GCaMP-only.
